title: Amber Irish Cheese Casserole
description: A creamy, cheesy casserole with the warm flavors of Indian spices, perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.notes: Whole milk for a richer flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced and sautéed with the onion

instructions: Grease the casserole dish with butter.
Sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
In a separate saucepan, heat the beer over medium heat.
Add the Indian Cheese and stir until melted.
Add the milk and stir until the mixture thickens.
Add the authentic Indian Spice Blend and stir well.
Combine the beer mixture and sautéed onion mixture.
Pour the mixture into the greased casserole dish.
Top with additional Indian Cheese, if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
